name: hooks
description: Open source hooks library for AI coding agents. Storage is a data-backend switch, never a deployment mode: local SQLite at ~/.hasna/hooks/hooks.db by default, or PostgreSQL when HASNA_HOOKS_DATABASE_URL is set with HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql (src/db/storage-sync.ts). The retired HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE / HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE deployment-mode variables are read as errors, not no-ops. The optional remote registry is a Cloudflare Workers API (D1 catalog + R2 artifacts, provisioned by `hooks cf deploy`) reached via HASNA_HOOKS_API_URL — an API route, not a storage backend. MCP is served by the `hooks mcp` subcommand (no separate mcp bin).

readiness.description: Declared for the supported-api surface contract. hooks serve (src/serve.ts) implements GET /health and the /api/v1/* registry routes; GET /ready is not implemented yet and returns 404 today.
